replication.target_description: PISA 2012 primary replication report evaluating eight moderation claims; assigned row-specific claim and test unresolved.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a substantive primary replication report titled Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate 8 claims from Seaton_AmEduResJourn_2010_Blxd. It names replication team Marco Ramljak and Carolin Nast, SCORE RR ID 6z3o2, OSF project https://osf.io/em34f, and source https://osf.io/download/cnbt5/. Study, project and SCORE identifiers match the neutral replication reference and URL. The neutral reference lists Parsons et al.; that author list and its date are not printed in this report. The report contains completed claim evaluations and a general discussion, so it is not merely a preregistration, although its introductory sample description remains prospective. No PDF was supplied. Target correspondence unresolved: neither row supplies a replication locator, study identifier or outcome description. Original-paper page locators alone cannot identify a claim within this report; the original paper is outside the assigned source group and was not inspected. Eight candidates: bl7k78/CULTPOS, gw9296/HEDRES, gp3k3v/INTMAT, mqwyw8/INSTMOT, bx4248/MATHEFF, 282qvz/ANXMAT, 482j4y/STRUDREL and 5821x4/BELONG. No target assigned by row order or numeric matching. Candidate sample only: expected 62,880 students nested in 4,877 schools and 60 countries. These are distinct nested analytic roles, not mutually exclusive groups to sum. No confirmed final target-model analytic N or final exclusion accounting is established; no arithmetic performed. Candidate replication effects: CULTPOS negative and >-0.1; MATHEFF negative and > -0.1; ANXMAT negative and not between -0.1 and -0.3; BELONG positive and below 0.1. HEDRES, INTMAT, INSTMOT and STRUDREL are described as nonsignificant. Coefficients printed within Coded claim quotations concern the original study and are not replication estimates. The report gives seven successful claim verdicts and one failed verdict (ANXMAT). Alpha .01 criteria and qualitative significance were not substituted for a same-test printed p bound. The report names Seaton.replication.final.html as full output/results, but that file is not supplied and acquisition is prohibited. No absence inference about that uninspected output is made. Original side is an unassigned placeholder only. All assigned replication fields remain unverified pending target identification. This row gives original-paper locator 'p. 28'.
